no_overlap_check.note: Presented as dropping a branch that 'can never trigger because positions are increasing'; positions are increasing but can overlap (x x x), so overlapping occurrences now merge twice and duplicate symbols, and segmentation of the reference corpus changes.

trust_final_segment.note: Presented as skipping a vocabulary lookup for word-final segments because 'they are almost always in-vocabulary'; out-of-vocabulary final segments are no longer split back into known units. No upstream test segments with a vocabulary.

sorted_pairs.note: Presented as reading the best merge from a sorted candidate list; it sorts every candidate list instead of a single min() pass, so the merge loop does more work for the same result.
